items.title: Large-scale Ukrainian drone attack kills three in Moscow region, says Russia

items.summary_zh: 真主党增加了使用小型第一人称视野(FPV)无人机来攻击以色列,包括被光纤电缆所控制的系统来躲避复杂的防御.

items.title: Foreign tourists are falling out of love with Goa - here's why
items.title_zh: 外国游客爱上了果阿
items.summary: It is just past noon at the crescent-shaped Palolem beach on the southern tip of Goa's long, sandy coastline. The sun is blinding hot, but that has not deterred the tourist hordes from splashing about in the ocean.
items.summary_zh: 刚过正午 在果阿长长沙地海岸线南端的 月亮状的帕洛莱姆海滩上 阳光正在闪烁,但这并没有阻止旅游群在海洋中飘来飘去。

items.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
items.title_zh: 黎巴嫩说,在美国宣布延长停火时,有六人死于以色列袭击。
items.summary: An Israeli air strike on a town in southern Lebanon has killed six people, including three paramedics, according to Lebanon's health ministry. It comes as the US said the two countries had agreed to a 45-day ceasefire.
items.summary_zh: 据黎巴嫩卫生部称,以色列对黎巴嫩南部一城镇的空袭已造成6人死亡,其中包括3名护理人员。 美国说两国已经同意45天的停火。

items.title: Taiwan insists it is independent after Trump warning

items.summary: Taiwan has insisted it is a sovereign, independent nation, after US President Donald Trump cautioned it against formally declaring independence from China.
items.summary_zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普告诫台湾不要正式宣布从中国独立之后,台湾一直坚持认为自己是一个主权的独立国家.

items.title: Whale found dead near Danish island after German rescue operation

items.summary_zh: 一只在德国上海滩后获救的座头鲸被发现死在了丹麦岛附近.

items.title: Toddlers among more than 50 schoolchildren kidnapped in Nigeria

items.summary: Gunmen have kidnapped more than 50 children from three schools in the same town in north-eastern Nigeria, teachers and parents have told the BBC.

items.title: Rescue diver dies during search for bodies of Italians who drowned in Maldives caves

items.title: Freight train and bus crash kills at least eight in Bangkok

items.title: Senior IS leader killed in joint operation, US and Nigeria say

items.summary: Nigeria and the United States say they have killed a senior Islamic State (IS) leader in a joint-operation.
items.summary_zh: 尼日利亚和美国称他们在一次联合行动中杀死了一位伊斯兰国高级领导人.

items.title: US planning to charge ex-Cuban leader Raúl Castro

items.title: Switzerland to open secret files on Auschwitz 'Angel of Death' Mengele

items.summary_zh: 瑞士联邦情报局表示,它最终会打开关于臭名昭著的纳粹战争罪犯Josef Mengele的被长期封存的档案,但是没有说什么时候.

items.summary_zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普在2016年印第安纳州竞选集会上踏上舞台时,他明确指出了一件事:中国是美国的主要经济对抗者.

items.title: Watch: What did we learn from Trump's visit to China?
